stp.title: Stopped by the engine
stp.sub: Every order the risk engine stopped by itself, how sure the rule was and what became of it, so a wrong rule shows within days.

kpi.flaggedFoot: Delivered all the same {pct} of the time or more, over at least {n} ended stops
kpi.flaggedOff: Set a warning share in the card below to flag rules
kpi.sparedFoot: Orders the good-customer override kept from a hold or an automatic advance request

rules.d: Each rule's stops and how they ended. The wrong rate is the share delivered all the same, out of the stops that ended.

why.levelAsk: A risk level's ask, sent by itself
why.refuserAsk: A repeat refuser's terms, sent by itself

list.d: Newest first. Open an order to see its timeline.
list.empty: The engine stopped no order in these days.

stp.cut: More stops than the report lists: only the newest {n} are listed and counted. Raise the most rows in the card below.
stp.note: The report only reads. To change a rule or the good-customer override, go to Orders › Risk rules.

card.d: How many days the report shows, when a rule is flagged, and how many stops it lists.
card.daysHelp: 1 to 92, today included. A week as shipped.
card.warn: Flag a rule when this share (%) was delivered all the same
card.warnHelp: 1 to 100. Empty: never flag. Example: 40 flags a rule when 4 in 10 of its ended stops were delivered anyway.
card.minStops: Fewest ended stops before a rule can be flagged
card.minStopsHelp: 1 to 1,000. Keeps one unlucky order from flagging a rule.

stp.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change settings can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this meanwhile. The card now shows theirs; change it again if needed.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was saved; try again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved; try again.
